name: Banana Bonda
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour (maida) or wheat flour
instructions: 1. Mash the peeled bananas thoroughly in a bowl until smooth.
2. Add the powdered jaggery and mix until completely dissolved.
3. Add the flour, cardamom powder, salt, and baking soda, mixing to form a thick, drop-able batter.
4. Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
5. Carefully drop small spoonfuls of the batter into the hot oil.
6. Fry until the bondas turn a deep golden brown on all sides.
7. Remove and drain on paper towels before serving warm.
description: Banana Bonda, known locally as Vazhappazha Bonda, is a classic Tamil Nadu snack. It is a popular tea-time comfort food often prepared using overripe bananas, reflecting the traditional cultural value of minimizing food waste while creating delightful, sweet treats.
